newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: IMF issues Argentine waiver for first half 96 goal.
newsitem.headline: IMF issues Argentine waiver for first half 96 goal.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) issued Wednesday a waiver to Argentina for its failed 1996 first half fiscal goals, private news agency DyN reported.
The IMF also said that it will issue a letter of intent on October 1 in which it will set Argentina's fiscal goals for the entire year, DyN said.
"Today they approved the waiver and (on) the 30th the Fund will have the letter of intent for the entire year," Cabinet Chief Jorge Rodriguez told the news agency.
Argentina had agreed last February with the IMF that its fiscal deficit would not exceed $2.5 billion this year, but reached that figure by mid-year.
